data.body:
fix-bug:investigation

## Root Cause
**O(N) subprocess model under concurrent load**. The hook spawns 2 grep subprocesses per file (1 grep + 1 grep -v pipe). With 1204 tests/*.sh files that is 2408 fork()/exec() calls per hook run. Under normal unloaded conditions (~6s) this comfortably fits the 30s budget. Under concurrent pre-commit runs from parallel worktree sessions (confirmed in precommit-timeouts.log: 11 kills at 2026-06-03 12:29:50), macOS fork() contention causes per-subprocess cost to spike, pushing the total past 30s.

**Confirmed reproduction**: 11 concurrent instances: 32.8s > 30s = exit 124. Timeout log at /tmp/agent-a15b6e1e5186ae595-test-artifacts-agent-a15b6e1e5186ae595/precommit-timeouts.log confirms this is NOT a one-off.

**Secondary bug confirmed**: The wrapper (pre-commit-wrapper.sh line 95) runs bash -c "$COMMAND_STRING" with no forwarding of $4+ positional args that pre-commit passes when pass_filenames:true. The hook ALWAYS does the full 1204-file scan regardless of how many files are staged.

## Exact Files and Lines
- Hook implementation: plugins/dso/scripts/check-mktemp-tmpdir.sh lines 77-90 (per-file for-loop with 2 grep spawns)
- Wrapper: plugins/dso/scripts/pre-commit-wrapper.sh line 95 ($4+ not forwarded)
- Pre-commit config: .pre-commit-config.yaml line 28 (30s budget, pass_filenames:true)

## Scaling Profile
- N=3: 45ms | N=10: 59ms | N=30: 167ms | N=100: 614ms | N=1000: 5254ms | N=1204: 6087ms
- Linear at ~5ms/file due to subprocess spawn cost
- Under 11 concurrent runs: 32.8s (TIMEOUT); vs grep -r fix: 414ms

## Fix Approach
**Replace per-file for-loop with single grep -r pass** (preferred over raising budget):
- Current: for f in files; do grep ... "$f" | grep -v ... done  → O(N) subprocesses
- Proposed: grep -rnE <pattern> tests/ --include='*.sh' --exclude-dir=fixtures | grep -v marker
- Unloaded speedup: 6087ms → 107ms (52x); Under 11 concurrent: 32.8s → 0.41s (80x)
- Correctness verified: bad pattern detected, fixtures excluded, suppression marker honored
- When explicit file args are passed (pre-commit pass_filenames path), the hook should use grep on the explicit file list rather than grep -r (O(staged-N) = typically 1-10 files, trivially fast)

## Red Test Plan (tests/hooks/ conventions)
tests/scripts/test-check-mktemp-tmpdir.sh (extend existing test file):
1. test_completes_under_budget_with_large_file_set: create N=50 compliant tests/*.sh files in temp tree, time hook, assert elapsed < 5s (well under 30s budget)
2. test_correctness_bad_pattern_still_fails: create single bad test file (mktemp /tmp/...), assert exit 1 (RED gate for fix correctness)
Both tests follow existing mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/..." pattern and run_check() helper convention already in the test file.
